meta.prompt: Where is my package? Today is Sat 15 Nov. Show a tracking card: the item (Nikon Z fc camera body), carrier DHL Express, tracking number JD014600003SE, estimated delivery Tue 18 Nov and how many days away that is, and the shipment's five stages as a timeline with the current one marked: Label created (Nov 12), Picked up (Nov 13), In transit (Nov 14, current), Out for delivery, Delivered. Say which stage it is at ("Stage 3 of 5"). And a field where I can type delivery instructions and a Save button; once saved the card shows them back to me as saved.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Where is my package?" "Nikon Z fc camera body" icon:"local_shipping" status:"In transit" tone:accent
  Steps steps:["Label created","Picked up","In transit","Out for delivery","Delivered"] current:3
  Row between
    Text.fieldLabel "DHL Express · JD014600003SE"
    Text.strong "Stage 3 of 5"
  Row between
    Text.muted "Estimated delivery"
    Text.strong "Tue 18 Nov · in 3 days"
  Text.caption "Label created Nov 12 · Picked up Nov 13 · In transit since Nov 14"
  state instructions=""
  state saved=false
  if !saved
    InputField "Delivery instructions" "e.g. leave with the neighbour" =instructions lines:3
    ActionButton "Save" primary icon:"save" enabled:=instructions!="" -> saved=true
  if saved
    Callout "Instructions saved" "{instructions}" tone:good icon:"check_circle"
